title: Raise bronze_ingest_wgi per_page to cut the World Bank request count ~36 -> ~6
description: Every World Bank API request is an independent chance to hit the intermittent read timeout that stopped bronze_WGI completing on 2026-08-03. At per_page=1000 a run issued ~36 requests (6 indicators x ~6 pages at ~5,150 records each); at per_page=10000 the API reports pages=1 per indicator, so a run issues ~6. Cutting the request count is the single highest-leverage reliability change available and was named as such in task-050, which deliberately excluded it because — unlike the retry constants — it changes the HAPPY PATH and therefore breaks comparability with the task-012_1 baseline. Erik took that trade-off knowingly on 2026-08-03 rather than wait out the API degradation.
acceptanceCriteria: per_page is a named module-level constant (API_PAGE_SIZE), not an inline literal, matching the constant style task-050 established.
A run fetches each indicator in a single request where the record count allows it, cutting the per-run request count from ~36 to ~6.
Pagination still works if an indicator ever exceeds one page — the loop remains driven by the API's own metadata 'pages' value rather than assuming a single page.
No other request parameter changes, so the bronze contract and the resulting bronze_WGI schema are untouched.
The baseline consequence is recorded where it will be read: in the notebook comment, in task-012_5's notes, and in performance_optimized.md.
notes: CREATED 2026-08-03 (/work, Erik-approved). Splits out the change task-050 note 3 explicitly deferred ('DELIBERATELY NOT DOING: raising per_page ... Revisit AFTER task-012_5 closes'). Erik chose to take it now instead.

BASELINE CONSEQUENCE — the accepted cost, recorded so it is not rediscovered as a surprise: the task-012_1 baseline measured bronze_WGI at 73s with per_page=1000. That figure is no longer like-for-like, so task-012_5 cannot report a bronze_WGI delta against it. The bronze stage must be annotated as RE-BASELINED rather than compared. The optimizations task-012_5 actually exists to measure (V-Order and broadcast hints from task-012_3, index DDL from task-012_4) act on silver and gold, so the silver/gold comparison — where the real signal is — stays intact.

IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-03 (inline, not via implement-agent — session-level instruction is not to dispatch subagents unless asked). Added API_PAGE_SIZE = 10000 beside the task-050 constants and changed the request param to str(API_PAGE_SIZE). Rewrote the constant block's comment, which previously stated per_page was deliberately NOT tuned, so it now records the raise, the arithmetic and the baseline consequence.

VERIFIED LOCALLY: ast.parse OK; 6 CELL markers intact; 249/249 pytest pass. NOT verified against the live API — the record count per indicator (~5,150) is from the 2026-08-03 partial run, so pages=1 at per_page=10000 is arithmetic, not an observation. The first real run is the confirmation; if the World Bank caps per_page below 10000 the loop still paginates correctly, just with less benefit.
